definitions.explanation: Many things or people doing something at the same time together.

examples.english: The flowers all bloomed at once.

examples.japanese: {一斉|いっせい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{立|た}ち{上|あ}がった→立ち上がる：02128_tachiagaru⟧。
⟦{合図|あいず}→合図：01675_aizu⟧とともに、⟦{選手|せんしゅ}→選手：03823_senshu⟧⟦たち→達：01551_tachi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{一斉|いっせい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{走|はし}り{出|だ}した→走り出す：06679_hashiridasu⟧。
examples.english: At the signal, the athletes all started running at once.

notes:
{一斉|いっせい} indicates many people or things acting at the same time. It emphasizes the coordinated, simultaneous nature of the action.

FORMS:
- Adverb: {一斉|いっせい}に (all at once)
- Modifier: {一斉|いっせい}の + noun (simultaneous ~)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {一斉|いっせい}に{立|た}ち{上|あ}がる: to stand up all at once
- {一斉|いっせい}{検査|けんさ}: simultaneous inspection/crackdown
- {一斉|いっせい}{攻撃|こうげき}: coordinated attack
- {一斉|いっせい}{送信|そうしん}: mass broadcast/transmission
- {一斉|いっせい}{休業|きゅうぎょう}: simultaneous closure

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {同時|どうじ}に: at the same time — neutral, factual
- {一斉|いっせい}に: all at once — emphasizes coordinated group action
- {一気|いっき}に: all in one go — emphasizes doing something without stopping
